plain: Using something, such as money, in the wrong way

webster.text: A wrong application; an application to a wrong person or purpose.

example.quote: There could not be any misapplication of it.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
